address: calle del Scaleter, sestiere San Polo 2202/a, Venice, 30125, Italy
bio: Among a labyrinth of alleys and canals, stands the trattoria Da Fiore, elegant and with a family atmosphere. The main hall warmly welcomes guests, while a romantic terrace hosts a table for two by the canal. The cuisine, true to the land, will allow you to enjoy fried moleche [soft-shell crabs] (when in season): an experience not to be missed! Last but not least, there is the wine cellar, which has a fine selection of the most sought-after French and Italian wines (about 800 labels). Equally impressive is the selection of grappas, cognacs and whiskies....
